vars.subject: car handling (the Car class in scripts/car.gd: throttle, drag, braking, reverse, steering and the grass)
vars.rules: throttle accelerates the car along its heading in proportion to how far it is pressed, the top speed is ACCEL / DRAG and half throttle tops out at half of it, coasting slows the car, braking stops a moving car without taking it into reverse, holding the brake once stopped reverses up to REVERSE_MAX, a standing car does not turn and a slow one (under TURN_SPEED) turns less than at full lock, reversing turns the nose the other way, above GRIP / speed radians a second the car cannot turn tighter, the grass (road false) holds the car to ACCEL / GRASS_DRAG, and a straight run takes the car as far at 30 ticks a second as at 120

vars.feature: race positions: Race.standings() returns the car indices (Array[int]) from first to last, and Race.position_of(i) the place of car i, 1 for the leader. Cars that have taken the flag come first, in the order they took it (Race.finish_order); the rest are ranked by laps completed, then by the gates passed in the lap in progress (LapTracker.gates_passed), then by the distance still to drive along the track to their next gate (less is ahead), and cars still level by their index
